questions.questionText: Which alkali metal is stored under oil to prevent violent reaction with moisture?
questions.explanation: Sodium reacts vigorously with air and water.

questions.questionText: Gas liberated when dilute Acid reacts with Metal carbonate:
questions.explanation: Metal carbonate + acid -> Salt + Water + CO₂.

questions.questionText: Common oxidation state of halogen elements (Group 17) in compounds:
questions.explanation: Halogens gain 1 electron to complete octet (-1 state).

questions.questionText: Process of coating iron with zinc layer to prevent rusting:
questions.explanation: Galvanizing shields iron with sacrificial zinc.

questions.questionText: Most abundant metal element in Earth's crust:
questions.explanation: Aluminum is most abundant metal in Earth's crust (~8%).
